description: This file defines the core store and state management for a 3D rendering context using React, Three.js, and Zustand. It includes interfaces, types, and a function to create and manage the application's root state, handling rendering, camera, viewport, and event subscriptions.

classes.name: Intersection
classes.description: Extends THREE.Intersection with an eventObject property.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Represents a subscription with a React ref, priority, and store reference.

classes.name: Size
classes.description: Defines width, height, top, and left dimensions.

classes.name: Viewport
classes.description: Extends Size with additional camera and viewport properties.

classes.name: Performance
classes.description: Tracks performance metrics and includes a regress method.

classes.name: Renderer
classes.description: Interface with a render method for scene and camera.

classes.name: InternalState
classes.description: Holds internal state variables for interaction, hover, subscribers, and event handling.

classes.name: XRManager
classes.description: Interface for managing XR connection and disconnection.

classes.name: RootState
classes.description: Main application state including renderer, camera, scene, controls, viewport, and internal state.

methods.name: createStore
methods.description: Creates and initializes the root store managing the 3D scene state, handling resize, camera updates, and subscriptions.
